label: 4.1.1.a
procedure_text: Examine the account management procedure to verify that it requires a unique user identifier for each person and each automated process.

label: 4.1.1.b
procedure_text: Examine the account list of a sample of system components to verify that no user identifier is assigned to more than one person.

label: 4.1.2.a
procedure_text: Examine the leaver procedure to verify that it defines who disables user identifiers and within what time.

label: 4.1.2.b
procedure_text: Examine records for a sample of people who left in the last six months to verify that their user identifiers were disabled within one business day.

label: 4.2.1.a
procedure_text: Examine review records to verify that reviews took place at the frequency that Table 1 specifies.

label: 4.2.1.b
procedure_text: Interview the people responsible to verify that access identified as no longer needed was removed.

label: 4.2.1.c
procedure_text: Examine a sample of privileged accounts to verify that each one has a documented business reason.

label: 5.1.1.a
procedure_text: Examine system configurations to verify that stored member data is encrypted with strong cryptography.

label: 5.1.1.b
procedure_text: Examine key storage locations to verify that keys are not stored with the data that they protect.

label: 5.1.2.a
procedure_text: Examine the retention policy to verify that it defines a retention period for each category of member data.

label: 5.1.2.b
procedure_text: Examine a sample of data stores to verify that they hold no member data older than the defined retention period.

label: 5.2.1.a
procedure_text: Examine the configuration of a sample of external connections to verify that they accept only the protocol versions that the requirement allows.

label: 5.2.1.b
procedure_text: Observe a sample of transmissions to verify that member data is encrypted in transit.

label: 6.1.1.a
procedure_text: Examine logging configurations to verify that access to member data is recorded.

label: 6.1.1.b
procedure_text: Examine a sample of log entries to verify that each one includes all the listed fields.

label: 6.1.2.a
procedure_text: Examine log storage to verify that audit logs from the last 12 months are available.

label: 6.1.2.b
procedure_text: Examine review records to verify that reviews took place at least once each week.

label: 6.1.2.c
procedure_text: Interview the people responsible to verify that they follow up on unusual activity.
